verification.publicBrowserScope: Retained website verification from a1303c9; website ce4485f is unchanged. Correction reran all local browser scenarios, the production MCP match, and exact public asset readback, not these public browser scenarios.

fullProductionMatch.transport: two real stdio MCP agents + Colyseus WebSockets

convex.counting: query REST + mutation REST + delivered authorization query results (includes initial/reconnect results); subscription initiations are not double-counted

fullProductionMatch.note: Same-host scripted clients, not model inference or two physical networks. Full duration with hold gambits avoids an early wipe.

limitations: MCP agents use scripted policies and real stdio tools; no model inference or new two-machine/network test.
Capacity is a roughly 30-second stationary 80-swarm loopback fixture, not full-length concurrent WAN matches, maximum-rate inputs or simultaneous replay reports.
Unfinished matches are process-local and interrupted by server loss; completed reports, Elo and history are durable.
Account activation remains gated; the existing account card must review a cookie-authenticated live-session exchange.
The existing internal legacy subscription query is retained only for rollback during independent review; no new live client uses it.

reviewCorrection.evidenceSource: Full-match values use the persisted verifier JSON. Its stdout printed one later frame per stream because the open sockets continued receiving while writeFile awaited; the persisted counts are 6105/6114.
coverage: Durable-authority 90-second refresh and newly opened/reopened agent channels preserve private solo and opening choices through start and rematch; connected agents cannot override solo, and peer room data exposes no openings.
At 24 rooms, play/start/rematch return 503 without changing any local store records or creating a room; existing rematch votes survive rejection and a two-player retry succeeds when capacity frees.
deploymentWarnings: Compose used its default Docker builder because buildx is absent; build succeeded.
HTTPS returned one transient 502 during container replacement, then the retry and exact-build health readback passed.
reviewCorrection.scope: Runtime-only correction; website, Convex backend, account activation, DNS and public SSH unchanged. Fresh full-match, durable readback and capacity measurements above supersede prior-runtime values; prior values remain in the previous evidence commit.

resolvedIssues: Authorization adoption now preserves process-local private-room preferences.
The 24-room admission ceiling now includes the actual rematch route before readiness mutation.
An already-left SDK room caused verifier cleanup to wait forever; cleanup now skips closed rooms.
Playwright promise-based DNS still used the runner cached NXDOMAIN; the verification-only resolver pin now covers callback and promise paths.
An actual offline browser check exposed an unintended dependency on the online bundle; local SSE and same-match reload now pass without it.
Public cold entry could be clicked before asynchronous configuration installed its handler; final website keeps it disabled until ready.
